name: Carmilla : Crimson Moon
source:
A dark gothic yuri retelling of Sheridan Le Fanu’s classic 1872 vampire novella Carmilla. 
In the shadowed halls of a crumbling 19th-century Styrian castle, innocent Laura surrenders to Carmilla: a captivating vampire who tempts her soul toward corruption, awakening ecstasy... and risking eternal damnation.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4488990/]Steam[/url]]
